'''S. Moshuddaa''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] affiliated with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-run financial [[NewsNet]], the [[Nal Hutta Kal'tamok/Legends|''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok'']]. Moshuddaa reported on several stories during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including [[Spaaga Core, Inc.]]'s move into the [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca stone]] market.<ref name="GNN10" /> S. Moshuddaa subsequently produced for the ''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok'' an in-depth analysis of the various newsfeeds available during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="GNN11">{{JournalCite|11|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
S. Moshuddaa's byline in "[[Galaxywide NewsNets|Annual NewsNet Summary]]" in ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11]]'' is spelled as "S. Moshudda."<ref name="GNN11" />
